title: Authenticated principal is not MCP clientInfo
summary: Project authority comes from verified HTTPS application context key mcp.principal. MCP clientInfo is diagnostic/self-reported metadata and cannot claim ownership, read requests or author work.
invariants: Fail closed when mcp.principal is absent for protected operations.
Do not infer authority from peer IP or arbitrary HTTP headers.
mTLS admission and certificate-to-principal mapping remain separate concerns.

provenance.claim: Grounded in sealed MCP Project Service v0.2-dev7 package.
